prompt:
Write a Solidity contract for Ethereum mainnet. Output ONLY the Solidity source file. No explanation, no markdown fences.

A yield-bearing share vault named exactly `Vault`:

  constructor(address _asset)
  function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256)
  function deposit(uint256 assets) external returns (uint256 shares)
  function redeem(uint256 shares) external returns (uint256 assets)

Yield arrives as a PLAIN TRANSFER of the asset to the vault - no callback, no
notification. It must accrue pro-rata to existing shareholders.

It will be graded by a FUZZ CAMPAIGN over random amounts, not fixed cases.
Every one of these must hold:

  1. Yield reaches holders. Deposit, then a direct transfer arrives, then
     redeem -> you get back more than you put in, and never more than
     deposit + yield.
  2. No free money. An immediate deposit-then-redeem round trip never returns
     more than was put in. Not one wei.
  3. Solvency. Every holder must be able to redeem in full without the vault
     overdrawing itself, in any order.
  4. The donation / first-depositor inflation attack must not work: someone who
     deposits dust and then transfers assets directly to the vault must not be
     able to steal the next depositor's funds.

Note that 1 and 4 pull against each other - you cannot simply ignore direct
transfers, because that is where the yield comes from.

Do not import anything - the file must compile standalone on solc 0.8.28.
Declare any interfaces you need in the file itself. Use `pragma solidity ^0.8.20;`
and an SPDX line.
